parent.immutability_rule: Parent package remains untouched; V6.3.0 is a separate descendant with a fresh database.

architecture.runtime_mode: feature-flagged shadow/pilot; legacy mastery remains authoritative until governed migration

forward_system_boundaries.scoremax: learner delivery, assessment, evidence, mastery, recovery, Study Plan, progress and exams
forward_system_boundaries.growth_engine: asynchronous event/outbox consumer; cannot control academic truth or learner mastery

important_release_guardrails: Academic Reviewer Workspace is retained only as historical compatibility code and is hidden from the forward V6.3 workflow.
Synthetic QA evidence is invalid for real learner mastery.
Dependent variants cannot inflate independent mastery.
Mandatory Claim Family gates can block or reopen mastery.
Full-exam execution losses remain separate from content mastery.
Public cloud deployment, final browser UX acceptance and real learner calibration remain later gates.
